offline: Nta murandasi ufite. Ubutumwa bushya buzagaragara niwongera kugira murandasi.

channels.web_push: Kumenyeshwa kuri iyi telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa

push.onBody: Tuzakumenyesha igihe cyo kugenda, igihe uhamagawe n'igihe gahunda ihindutse.
push.whyBody: Tuzakubwira igihe cyo kugenda ku ivuriro n'igihe uhamagawe, nubwo MediLink ifunze. Mushakisha yawe izahita igusaba uruhushya.
push.deniedBody: Kugira ngo ubifungure, jya mu igenamiterere rya mushakisha yawe kuri MediLink, wemere kumenyeshwa, hanyuma ugaruke kuri iyi paji.
push.ios: Kuri iPhone, banza ushyire MediLink kuri ekarani y'ibanze
push.iosStep1: Kanda buto yo Gusangiza muri Safari.
push.iosStep3: Fungura MediLink uhereye kuri ekarani y'ibanze, ufungure kumenyeshwa aho.
push.unsupportedBody: Uzakomeza kubona ubutumwa bwose hano no kuri imeyili. Chrome, Firefox na Edge birabishobora.
push.failed: Ntibyashobotse gufungura cyangwa guhagarika kumenyeshwa. Ongera ugerageze.

banner.title: Fungura kumenyeshwa tukubwire igihe cyo kugenda
banner.body: Telefoni yawe ikubwira igihe uhamagawe n'igihe gahunda ihindutse.

inbox.title: Ubutumwa
inbox.emptyBody: Ibyibutsa bya gahunda, amakuru y'umurongo n'ubutumwa bw'amavuriro yawe bizagaragara hano.

detail.notFoundBody: Bushobora kuba bwarakuweho, cyangwa ari ubw'indi konti.

settings.title: Igenamiterere ry'ubutumwa
settings.conflict: Ibyo wahisemo biracyahari. Fungura verisiyo nshya, hanyuma wongere ubike.
settings.languageHint: Rukoreshwa no kuri imeyili n'iyi porogaramu.
settings.channelsHint: Ubutumwa buhora bugaragara muri MediLink. Hitamo ahandi wifuza kubwakira.
settings.locked: Ufite itike ku murongo, bityo nibura uburyo bumwe bwo kukugeraho ku butumwa bwihutirwa bugomba kuguma bukora kugeza gahunda irangiye.

levelHint.important: Igihe cyo kugenda, impinduka kuri gahunda

settings.quietHint: Ubutumwa bwihutirwa buracyaza. Amasaha ni aya Kigali.
